node.title: Re: Data::Dumper: What the Cabal doesn't want you to know.
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I'd second [SankoR]'s [id://11152491|point] about using something like JSON. But for [doc://Data::Dumper], see my module [mod://Data::Undump::PPI]. [mod://Data::Dump] is a little trickier because its output includes stuff like the range operator, repetition operator, and even [doc://MIME::Base64]. Of course there's [doc://eval], but that's a giant security hole with input that you don't have 100% control over.
